enemies.name: Esqueleto de Cripta
enemies.subject: A thin crypt skeleton warrior of yellowed, weathered bones, leaning slightly forward. A rusted short sword is gripped in one bony hand; a few torn dark burgundy cloth strips remain tied around the ribs and waist. Fragile, spare silhouette, no armor.

enemies.name: Bandido de la Marca
enemies.subject: A tired adult road thief with a weathered face, worn brown-black leather coat over padded clothes, a burgundy scarf, a practical short sword and a small battered round buckler. Guarded, slightly wide stance; ordinary human proportions, no plate armor.

enemies.name: Guardián de Hierro
enemies.subject: A massive empty suit of aged iron plate armor, broad shoulders and heavy gauntlets, a dark violet slit visible inside the closed visor, carrying a heavy square-headed war hammer. The armor is cold, worn and unadorned, with only a small burgundy cloth remnant.

enemies.name: Cultista Carmesí
enemies.subject: A lean human ritualist in layered charcoal robes, dark hood, angular iron half-mask, restrained burgundy inner garment and cords across the chest. Ash-stained gloves, a small ritual knife at the belt and a small faceted violet crystal held in one hand; solemn and physically grounded.

enemies.name: Coloso de Hueso
enemies.subject: A towering skeletal brute assembled from enormous mismatched bones, hunched shoulders, deep visible ribcage, heavy arms and thick legs. Broken fragments of dark stone and old iron hang from the shoulders; a small dim violet fracture sits deep beneath the ribs. Ancient, massive silhouette, no gore.

enemies.name: Limitless
enemies.subject: A tall, unstable entity with no recognizable human face or fixed anatomy: a narrow charcoal-black shroud of torn cloth and smoke-like layers, long ragged edges, a small fractured violet core visible through the chest. Keep the form solemn and restrained; no flames, no human face, no identifiable origin, no crown.

enemies.name: Acólito del Juramento
enemies.subject: A slender hooded devotee of the crypt in a worn charcoal robe, pale bone half-mask and a small aged-brass oath token on a cord. Narrow silhouette, simple belt, ash on the hem; no written vows or symbols.

enemies.name: Peregrino de Hueso
enemies.subject: A hunched skeletal pilgrim in a weathered gray travel cloak, carrying a crooked bone staff and a small iron cage lantern with a dim ember inside. Thin limbs, exposed aged bones and a quiet, burdened posture; no armor.

enemies.name: Bandido de Ceniza
enemies.subject: A lean soot-covered raider wearing a practical dark leather coat, simple half-mask, one uneven shoulder guard and a chipped curved blade held low. One muted ember-orange cloth strip is tied at the waist; quick guarded stance, not an elite knight.

enemies.name: Guardián de Brasas
enemies.subject: A broad armored guardian in heavy weathered steel plate, rounded shoulder guards and a dark iron war hammer. A few restrained dull ember seams show at the joints, as if the armor retains heat from a dead forge; no bright glow.

enemies.name: Sacerdote de Escoria
enemies.subject: An older human priest in layered soot-dark robes, iron rings and a heavy staff topped with a small caged forge lantern. His face is weathered and visible, hands stained with ash; solemn, imposing but human, with no skull mask.

enemies.name: Coro Hueco
enemies.subject: A single tall robed figure in charcoal and muted slate, wearing a smooth pale mask with no mouth. Small bone tokens rest at the shoulders and chest; layered robe folds suggest a chorus without adding extra bodies. Quiet and uncanny, no readable writing.

enemies.name: Guardiana de la Campana
enemies.subject: A composed adult woman sentinel in practical dark steel armor over a muted slate skirt, with a small broken bronze bell fragment secured at her belt and a straight sword held low. Natural proportions, calm watchful stance, no ornate crown.

enemies.name: Erudito del Espejo
enemies.subject: A slender older scholar with a pale tired face, simple ash-gray robe and narrow leather belt. A fractured hand mirror with a dull steel frame is held close to the chest; a few tiny reflective splinters sit at the collar. No equations, writing or glowing eyes.

enemies.name: Centinela de la Grieta
enemies.subject: A sturdy knight in weathered charcoal armor with a dark steel shield and a short spear. One fine muted-violet fracture crosses the breastplate; the light is contained inside the crack, not a glow around the body. Guarded defensive posture.

enemies.name: Encadenado de Plomo
enemies.subject: A weary middle-aged prisoner in a plain gray ash-stained robe, weighed down by thick lead chain around the torso and wrists. One length of chain drags from the belt; bowed shoulders and a still, exhausted stance, no wounds or gore.

enemies.name: Sabueso de Escoria
enemies.subject: A large four-legged black hound with powerful paws, short coarse fur and irregular plates of dark vitrified slag along its spine. A few faint ember seams appear beneath the plates; low alert stance and clear canine head, no extra limbs.

enemies.name: Polilla de Cal
enemies.subject: A large pale moth with broad dusty bone-white wings, soot-gray body, long delicate antennae and lightly worn wing edges. Wings held in a natural upright spread; powdery surface texture, small and eerie rather than monstrous.

items.name: Hoja Oxidada
items.subject: A short straight sword with a chipped, rust-eaten iron blade, a plain crossguard and a worn dark-leather grip. Practical and modest, no gem.

items.name: Hacha de Ceniza
items.subject: A compact hand axe with one broad dark-iron blade, ash-gray pitted surface and a leather-wrapped wooden haft. The head is slightly chipped; no flame.

items.name: Báculo Arcano
items.subject: A crooked staff of dark weathered wood with a small faceted violet crystal set into its head by aged iron prongs. The crystal is dim and solid, not glowing.

items.name: Coraza de Hierro
items.subject: A simple dark iron cuirass with a natural torso shape, scratched steel surface and plain leather side straps. No mannequin, insignia or extra armor pieces.

items.name: Placa del Guardián
items.subject: A heavier aged-steel breastplate with broad shoulder plates and muted burgundy leather faulds below. Solid and protective, distinct from a simple cuirass; no crest.

items.name: Escudo de Roble
items.subject: A compact kite shield built from dark oak planks, with a worn iron rim and a small central boss. Scratched wood grain, practical medieval construction.

items.name: Talismán de Brasa
items.subject: A small amber teardrop stone held in a worn bronze setting with a simple hanging loop. A dim warm inclusion sits inside the stone; it is a charm, not a flame.

items.name: Sigilo del Vacío
items.subject: A dark obsidian medallion with a clean circular hollow at its center and a faint muted-violet reflection inside the void. No runes, letters or bright aura.

items.name: Reliquia del Peregrino
items.subject: A small weathered carved-stone relic, like a worn marker carried on a journey: irregular rectangular silhouette, shallow hood-like notch and chipped edges. No readable marks or text.

items.name: Bremaje Curativo
items.subject: A small upright clear-glass vial with a narrow neck, dark cork stopper, worn bronze wire around the neck and deep muted carmine-red restorative liquid filling the lower half. Aged cloudy glass, no label.

items.name: Bremaje Mayor
items.subject: A slightly broader ornate clear-glass vial with a dark stopper, aged bronze neck ring and deep plum-red restorative liquid. Thick glass and a small metal shoulder clasp distinguish it from the common draught; no label.

items.name: Clavo del Umbral
items.subject: A long black-iron threshold nail with a small flat hammer head, tapered point and a narrow strip of worn burgundy cord wrapped near the head. Pitted, old metal, no glow.

items.name: Colmillo de Escoria
items.subject: One curved pale beast tooth with a dark vitrified root, a few hairline cracks and a small dull ember-colored seam. It remains clearly a tooth, not a weapon.

items.name: Manto sin Eco
items.subject: A folded charcoal hooded mantle of matte weathered cloth with a small tarnished clasp. Fine ash dust on the folds, compact readable silhouette, no mannequin.

items.name: Tónico de Cal
items.subject: A squat stoppered smoky-glass vial with a short neck, half-filled with opaque chalk-white tonic; a few pale flecks settle at the bottom. A thin bronze wire circles the neck, no label.
